name: gizza-ai/video-bake-rotation
summary: Bake a video's rotation metadata into upright pixels

tool.description: Bake a video's embedded rotation metadata/display matrix into the actual pixels and clear the rotate flag, fixing sideways phone clips in players that ignore orientation metadata. Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). The video is re-encoded to H.264 with CRF 23/preset medium so the orientation becomes universal; audio is stream-copied when container-compatible, or re-encoded to AAC when converting to mp4. Note: runs on the standalone page and the CLI (chat ffmpeg is unavailable).

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Video URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
